title: kaniko can send the build's Azure (Entra ID) access token to lookalike ACR registry hosts (CVE-2026-105769)
description: kaniko versions before 1.25.20 contain a vulnerability in the Azure Container Registry (ACR) credential helper that can cause it to send Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) access tokens to attacker-controlled lookalike registry hosts. This occurs when a Dockerfile references images from a hostname containing '.azurecr.io' or similar domains, allowing an attacker to receive live Azure Resource Manager tokens. The vulnerability is fixed in kaniko v1.25.20 by tightening hostname validation in the credential helper.
